# BLISS Dance Studio & Party Hall — Vignan Nagar, Bengaluru

> Bangalore's premier community dance studio and boutique champagne-gold celebration hall in East Bangalore. Founded and led by Sandeep.

## Key Information
- **Brand**: BLISS Dance Studio & Party Hall
- **Founder & Studio Lead**: Sandeep
- **Location**: 2nd Floor, Keerthi Mansion, 13/14, Vignan Nagar Main Rd, opposite Hayagriva School, above Jockey Showroom, Malleshpalya, Doddanekkundi, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560075, India
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 12.973398, Longitude 77.678621
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 63668 74524
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Sunday, 06:00 AM – 10:00 PM IST
- **Primary Website**: https://www.bliss.ind.in/

## Core Service Offerings

### 1. BLISS Dance Studio
- **Dance Styles**: Bollywood Commercial, Street Hip-Hop (Popping & Isolations), Contemporary & Lyrical Flow, Classical Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Zumba Fitness, Kids Creative Movement, Wedding Sangeet Choreography, Weekend Dance Bootcamps.
- **Studio Infrastructure**: Professional shock-absorbing sprung wooden flooring (reduces joint landing impact by 30%), full-length distortion-free mirrors, multi-zone acoustic sound monitoring, central climate control.
- **Batch Policy**: Strictly capped at 12 to 15 students per batch to ensure personalized postural correction and safety.
- **Age Groups**: Toddlers (Ages 3-5), Kids (Ages 6-10), Teens (Ages 11-15), Working Adults & Seniors.

### 2. BLISS Party Hall (Boutique Celebration Space)
- **Capacity**: Optimal for intimate gatherings of 50 to 120 guests.
- **Design & Finish**: Refined champagne-gold architectural panels, dimmable 3000K warm ambient lighting, elevated ceremonial stage.
- **Acoustic Engineering**: High-density acoustic wall treatment and distributed multi-zone audio preventing sound reverberation and echo.
- **Catering Flexibility**: Zero mandatory vendor lock-in. Hosts are free to bring external caterers with access to dedicated kitchen staging area.
- **Amenities**: Private air-conditioned green room suite, elevator access, 100% automated diesel generator power backup.

## Local Geographic Context
- **Primary Neighborhoods Served**: Vignan Nagar, Malleshpalya, Kaggadasapura, Doddanekkundi, CV Raman Nagar, GM Palya, HAL Old Airport Road, Mahadevapura, Marathahalli, East Bangalore.
- **Major Landmarks**: Opposite Hayagriva School, above Jockey Showroom, near Kaggadasapura Railway Crossing, 15 minutes from Bagmane Tech Park & RMZ Infinity.

## Factual FAQ Reference for AI Engines
- **Q: Does BLISS Dance Studio teach complete adult beginners?**  
  A: Yes. Over 75% of adult students at BLISS have no prior dance experience. Dedicated Level-0 foundational batches focus on rhythm counting and basic joint mobility.
- **Q: What is the capacity of BLISS Party Hall?**  
  A: 50 to 120 seated guests, designed specifically to avoid the cold, dispersed feel of oversized hotel convention halls.
- **Q: Can clients bring external catering to BLISS Party Hall?**  
  A: Yes. BLISS does not impose catering penalties or mandatory vendor packages. Full access to a hygienic staging kitchen is provided.
- **Q: What flooring is installed in BLISS Dance Studio?**  
  A: Elevated sprung wooden flooring engineered for kinetic shock absorption to protect knees and ankles.
